purpose: One ordered task map for the whole project after reading the repo docs: what is done, what is WIP, what is roadmap, and the next 30 things to build.

done.label: Accepted TN12 covenant proof core
done.evidence: Vault recovery, vault delayed withdrawal, assurance release/refund, escrow release/refund/cancel, and all seven role-separated positive paths are accepted on TN12.

done.label: Accepted payload app-state core
done.evidence: 30 accepted JSON wRPC payload events cover invoice, access-pass, auction, stable-value issuer, attestation, prediction/hedge, agent, and batch-assurance planner state.

done.label: Wallet review and submit handoff package
done.evidence: Submit registry, wallet-review readiness, wallet-connector spec, wallet-submit package, unsigned request templates, external signer gap, and wallet-standard mapping are built, checked, and documented.

done.label: Checkpointed indexer schema and fixture replay
done.evidence: Current 43 accepted records are checkpointed, persisted, shaped into tables, replayed from fixture data, joined with wallet-submit candidates, and preflighted for a future live endpoint.

done.label: Research boundary system
done.evidence: Mainstream direction, missing rails matrix, rail research triggers, and oracle source matrix keep high-impact app categories documented without overclaiming.

wip.label: Live wallet connector submit without local keys
wip.whyFirst: Everything user-facing depends on users reviewing and signing exact transactions without this repo holding keys.

wip.label: Durable node/RPC virtual-chain indexer
wip.whyFirst: Accepted app state must survive replay, rollback, and new events without hand-maintained txid fixtures.

wip.label: Batch-assurance custody from amount-matched pledge outputs
wip.whyFirst: Public-goods funding becomes real only when planner records map to spendable accepted outputs.

wip.label: Attestation signer provenance and reputation thresholds
wip.whyFirst: Oracle, prediction, hedge, and miner-signal flows need this before signals influence anything beyond review prompts.

roadmap.label: Mainnet-capable payment/indexer products
roadmap.condition: Wallet submit and durable indexing have real accepted evidence.

roadmap.label: TN12/Toccata covenant products
roadmap.condition: Wallet support, audits, fresh outputs, and mainnet-compatible covenant tooling exist.

roadmap.label: Research and future rails
roadmap.condition: Missing rails, source models, custody, oracles, anchors, settlement, and composition are explicit and tested.

tasks.title: Map unsigned wallet templates to a real wallet standard
tasks.why: This is the highest leverage blocker: every user-facing app needs no-local-key signing and exact transaction review.
tasks.definitionOfDone: One payload receipt and one v1 contract template are represented in a documented wallet/PSKB/PSKT/KSPT-compatible format with explicit preservation checks.

tasks.title: Run live virtual-chain endpoint preflight and adapter test
tasks.why: The invoice/app-state vertical is only real if new accepted transactions can be discovered, replayed, and rolled back without manually curated txids.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A configured hosted TN12 endpoint returns a bounded virtual-chain window that matches checkpointed payload/proof rows or records an explicit endpoint failure.

tasks.title: Keep batch-assurance alternate paths non-selected
tasks.why: Batch assurance now has accepted pledge outputs and an accepted release; the remaining risk is stale operator or refund-path state.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Release acceptance, refund non-selection, checkpoint replay, and operator status stay synchronized across artifacts and docs.

tasks.title: Turn escrow release/refund into a simple marketplace or freelance demo
tasks.why: Escrow is the clearest user-facing covenant app already backed by accepted TN12 proofs.
tasks.definitionOfDone: One buyer/seller/job flow shows listing review, selected action, unsigned wallet template handoff, external-signing gap, and accepted replay gate.

tasks.title: Add signer provenance, reputation, quorum, and stale-signal thresholds
tasks.why: Prediction, hedge, miner-signal, and oracle-adjacent flows cannot influence app state safely without signal quality controls.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Attestation registry records reporter identity, provenance, quorum/conflict state, recency, and whether the signal can influence review prompts.

tasks.title: Build auction settlement and refund drafts
tasks.why: Auctions already have accepted bid and planner payloads; settlement/refund is the next user-facing gap.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Winner settlement and loser refund drafts are reviewable, with custody-source and wallet-standard checks recorded.

tasks.title: Build agent-task release and refund drafts
tasks.why: Agent commitments have accepted task/proof/dispute payload state, but no payout lifecycle.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Release, refund, and dispute-hold drafts are generated from accepted lifecycle state and reviewed for custody source, reviewer decision, and wallet-standard readiness.

tasks.title: Build treasury/team-vault constrained spend drafts
tasks.why: Treasury controls are a practical business app and reuse the vault proof base.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Payroll and delayed-withdrawal drafts exist with exact next steps for role keys, source UTXOs, and wallet-standard requests.

tasks.title: Turn invoice receipts into a mainnet-readiness brief
tasks.why: Invoices are the shortest path to a real non-covenant app because they need payments, payloads, indexing, and wallet UX.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Brief names the payment/indexer pieces, wallet/indexer requirements, failure states, and launch blockers.

tasks.title: Harden access-pass expiry and issuer review
tasks.why: Access passes are simple user-facing apps, but duplicate/expired/issuer disputes must be explicit.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Accepted redemption counting handles expiry, issuer review, duplicate holder/pass attempts, and missing txids.

tasks.title: Record batch-assurance settlement evidence after one path is submitted
tasks.why: If a release or refund settlement path is submitted, every downstream page must distinguish accepted evidence from the still-unspent mutually exclusive alternatives.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Accepted or rejected TN12 evidence is recorded, checkpointed, and reflected in test matrix, status, submit registry, and UI copy without implying the alternate spend remains available.

tasks.title: Add stable-value issuer reserve and redemption review
tasks.why: Issuer-backed stable-value receipts are buildable now only if reserve/redemption trust is visible.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Issuer state tracks reserve attestations, redemption requests, accepted redemptions, signed-only exclusions, and not-native-stablecoin boundaries.

tasks.title: Build oracle risk dashboard as simulation-only
tasks.why: Kaskad/Eliott oracle work is high-impact, but this repo must first show source models, stale data, and manipulation risks.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Dashboard compares CEX median, arbitrage-simulated price, signed reporter, miner/RTD, DCLOB, and bridge-anchor source models without custody claims.

tasks.title: Write lending rail brief from Kaskad and missing-rails evidence
tasks.why: Lending attracts liquidity, but needs collateral custody, oracle, liquidation, and risk parameter rails this repo does not have yet.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Brief maps Kaskad/Igra assumptions to TN12 L1 covenant realities and states what the smallest honest lending simulation can be.

tasks.title: Write AMM/DEX rail brief before any swap UI
tasks.why: DEXs can bring liquidity, but reserve accounting, slippage, LP shares, ordering, and MEV are unsolved here.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Brief names reserve model, updater authority, slippage enforcement, LP accounting, ordering, and first non-custodial intent prototype.

tasks.title: Write bridge/source-chain anchor brief
tasks.why: Bridge and ZK language can overclaim fastest unless the anchored object and custody/exit assumptions are explicit.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Brief names block/header/proof/reporter object, finality, challenge, custody holder, exit path, and outage/reorg behavior.

tasks.title: Scout one tiny app on a based-rollup surface
tasks.why: Rollups may be the realistic near path for richer app state, but only if endpoint, bridge, wallet, and settlement assumptions are known.
tasks.definitionOfDone: One tiny app target is mapped to available endpoints/tooling, bridge model, wallet path, and L1 settlement relationship.

tasks.title: Submit safe role-separated invalid candidates from fresh expendable outputs
tasks.why: The local invalid-candidate map is useful, but TN12 rejection evidence needs fresh outputs so accepted proofs are not disturbed.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A selected set of wrong-signer/wrong-selector/wrong-output invalid attempts are submitted safely and recorded as rejection evidence.

tasks.title: Add user-facing vault product policy templates
tasks.why: Vaults are a strong business/user app if templates explain recovery, delay, daily limits, and signer roles clearly.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Templates cover personal recovery, team treasury, payroll, and inheritance with exact enforcement labels.

tasks.title: Build grants/public-goods workflow on assurance plus payout vault planning
tasks.why: This is a natural user-facing app that reuses assurance, batch pledge progress, and treasury payout planning.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Grant proposal, pledge progress, release conditions, refund conditions, payout plan, and evidence links are represented.

tasks.title: Build portfolio automation simulator only after attestation thresholds
tasks.why: Rules automation is attractive, but it must not trade, custody, or advise without signal and wallet rails.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Simulator records rule triggers, accepted signals, blocked custody actions, and review prompts only.

tasks.title: Write prediction/perps settlement boundary brief
tasks.why: Prediction and perps need oracle, margin, liquidation, matching, and settlement rules; current simulator is review-only.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Brief names oracle source, margin custody, matching, close/liquidate authority, stale odds handling, and no-advice/no-settlement boundaries.

tasks.title: Extend simple asset policy into redemption draft planning
tasks.why: Redeemable claims can be useful without native asset overclaims if issuer/indexer boundaries are clear.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Mint, transfer, burn, redemption, recovery, and issuer review are mapped to accepted payloads or wallet-reviewed drafts.

tasks.title: Add a project-priority dashboard panel
tasks.why: The repo needs one user-facing place to show done, WIP, roadmap, and next work without reading every doc.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Browser UI renders the generated next-work queue with clear status lanes and no hype.

tasks.title: Add a docs coverage check for priority queue source docs
tasks.why: The queue should fail checks if core docs disappear or stop carrying the key status concepts.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Check asserts source docs exist and include done/WIP/roadmap/project-plan references.

tasks.title: Refresh transaction API notes around wallet/wRPC submit realities
tasks.why: Future submit bugs should not rediscover REST payload dropping or v1 compute-budget serialization boundaries.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Notes point to the exact submit routes, payload-preservation rule, and tx v1 computeBudget requirements.

tasks.title: Update LLM review guide for new priority queue and research gates
tasks.why: Reviewers need to know which artifacts answer status and which ones are research-only.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Guide points reviewers to project plan, next-work queue, missing rails, research triggers, and oracle matrix before making claims.

tasks.title: Clean up GitHub Actions Node 24 deprecation warning
tasks.why: Pages currently deploys, but the workflow warning should be cleared before it becomes noise or a deadline.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Workflow uses current actions/runtime versions and Pages/check runs remain green.

tasks.title: Write fresh expendable output funding runbook
tasks.why: Several next TN12 tests need fresh outputs; the exact flow should be clear before any destructive or mutually exclusive spend.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Runbook names funding scripts, expected outputs, safety rules, and how to import outpoints without touching accepted proof history.

tasks.title: Add a reusable mainstream app brief template
tasks.why: Every future app idea should answer user job, PMF, lane, missing rails, prototype, and do-not-claim before code.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Template is referenced by the mainstream direction and research trigger docs.
